DSGN_1.details: Outline analysis workflow: (1) Acquire daily precipitation and streamflow data for 2023; (2) Clean each dataset; (3) Merge on date; (4) Inspect merged data; (5) Define correlation analysis (Pearson & Spearman); (6) Compute metrics and generate scatter & time-series plots; (7) Inspect outputs.

INFRA_1.details: Install required Python libraries: pandas, numpy, requests, matplotlib, scipy. Example: pip install pandas numpy requests matplotlib scipy

ACQ_Precip.details: Write a Python script using requests to fetch daily precipitation (mm) for NOAA station USW00024233 via NOAA NCDC API from 2023-01-01 to 2023-12-31. Use NOAA_TOKEN environment variable. Save as data/raw_precip.csv.

ACQ_Streamflow.details: Write a Python script using requests to fetch daily mean streamflow (cfs) for USGS site 14211720 via USGS Water Services API from 2023-01-01 to 2023-12-31. Save as data/raw_streamflow.csv.

ENG_Clean_Precip.details: Load data/raw_precip.csv with pandas. Parse 'date' column as datetime. Rename precipitation column to 'precip_mm'. Drop rows with missing values. Save cleaned data to data/clean_precip.csv.

ENG_Clean_Streamflow.details: Load data/raw_streamflow.csv with pandas. Parse 'date' column as datetime. Rename discharge column to 'streamflow_cfs'. Drop rows with missing values. Save cleaned data to data/clean_streamflow.csv.

ENG_Merge.details: Load data/clean_precip.csv and data/clean_streamflow.csv. Merge on 'date' using inner join. Save result as data/merged_hydro.csv.

INSP_Merged_Data.details: Display head, summary statistics, date range, and missing‐value counts for data/merged_hydro.csv for human inspection.

ui_instructions.prompt: Review the merged hydro dataset summary. Is the date range correct and are there no unexpected missing values or anomalies?

cyclic_routing.condition: Did the user approve the merged dataset?

DEV_Calc_Corr.details: Define functions to calculate Pearson and Spearman correlation coefficients and p-values between 'precip_mm' and 'streamflow_cfs' using scipy.stats.

EVAL_Plot_Corr.details: Write a Python script to load data/merged_hydro.csv; compute Pearson and Spearman correlations; save metrics to results/corr_metrics.json; generate scatter plot with regression line (plots/scatter.png) and dual-axis time series plot (plots/time_series.png).

INSP_Plot.details: Human inspects the generated plots (plots/scatter.png, plots/time_series.png) and correlation metrics.

ui_instructions.prompt: Do the plots and correlation results look correct?

cyclic_routing.condition: Did the user approve the plots and metrics?
